elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Vendor is obligated to provide transition assistance.
elements.evidence: The assistance obligation applies only “at Customer's request,” adding a condition not present in the preferred position.

elements.element: Transition assistance is available for up to six months.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly provides transition assistance “for up to six (6) months.”

elements.element: Transition assistance is provided at Vendor's then-current rates.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly applies “Vendor's then-current rates.”

elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Vendor is obligated to return or export all Customer Data.
elements.evidence: Return or download is required only following Customer's request, rather than automatically upon expiry or termination.

elements.element: Vendor returns or exports Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The 30-day period runs from Customer's request, which could occur later than expiry or termination.

elements.element: Customer Data is returned or exported in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: The clause requires a “commonly used, machine-readable format,” which satisfies this format requirement.

elements.element: After returning or exporting Customer Data, Vendor certifies that the Customer Data has been deleted.
elements.evidence: Although written certification is required, deletion is subject to routine-backup and legal-retention exceptions, so the clause does not require certification that all Customer Data has been deleted.

elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Vendor is obligated to provide transition assistance.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause makes assistance conditional on Customer's request.

elements.element: Transition assistance is available for at least 90 days.
elements.evidence: Availability for up to six months exceeds the fallback 90-day period.

elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Vendor is obligated to export Customer Data.
elements.evidence: The export obligation arises only upon Customer's request.

elements.element: Vendor exports Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The clause measures the 30-day deadline from Customer's request rather than from expiry or termination.

result.reason: Neither position is fully satisfied because the rendered clause conditions assistance and data export on a Customer request and measures the export deadline from that request rather than from expiry or termination. Certified deletion is also qualified by backup and legal-retention exceptions. In addition, termination of any single Order Form triggers return and deletion of all Customer Data, which could disrupt continuing services under other Order Forms and therefore may conflict with unrelated continuing rights. The added clause is also unnumbered and uses an overbroad all-data deletion trigger.
